ammonia.reason: Deamination of amino acids during 12-mo ripening gives low NH3 vs surface-ripened cheeses.

animal_barnyard.reason: Low p-cresol/indole from Tyr/Trp catabolism by lactococci and rind mites.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from chymosin and lactococcal proteinase partly debittered by peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so negligible 2-heptanone/2-nonanone.

browning.reason: Maillard between proteolysis-derived free amino groups and residual galactose on heating.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism to diacetyl/acetoin retained in 28.6% milkfat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Lipase/esterase lipolysis releasing butanoic and hexanoic acids during brined pressing and aging.

creaminess.reason: Moderate milkfat mouth-coating limited by pressed hard low-moisture para-casein matrix.

crumbliness.reason: Long proteolysis plus moisture loss and high salt-in-moisture weakening para-casein network.

firmness.reason: Pressed, brined, mite-ripened 12-mo moisture loss with Ca-phosphate crosslinked casein.

floral_honey.reason: Tyrolichus casei mite-secreted neral citral lemon note plus phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol.

fruity.reason: Esterification of ethanol with fatty acids to ethyl butanoate/hexanoate during long aging.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only so absent caprine 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2-methylbutanal/3-methylbutanal and pyrazines from proteolysis and annatto rind aging.

melt.reason: pH 5.51 para-casein flows on heating but reduced by 12-mo proteolysis and 3.4% salt.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from rind mite/fungal lipid oxidation, low in interior paste.

oil_off.reason: Coalesced milkfat pools released on heating from aged pressed matrix.

smoky.reason: No smoking step so no guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: Residual lactic acid plus low acetic acid from heterofermentative metabolism at pH 5.51.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata stretching and no aligned demineralized casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methionine catabolism to methional/DMDS and only low pasteurization heat, uncooked curd.

sweet.reason: Lactose exhausted leaving sweet amino acids Ala/Pro plus lactones and annatto caramel.

umami.reason: High free glutamate from rennet/plasmin and lactococcal peptidase proteolysis over 12 months.
